adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new behavior in `lib/post_revisor.rb` where `update_post` now calls `@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])`, introducing a validation-bypass branch when `skip_validations: true`. In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, the update path uses `revisor.revise!(user, ..., skip_validations: true, ...)`, so this new branch is exercised, but `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`'s update test only revises with obviously valid content ("muhahaha new contents!") and does not assert that an otherwise-invalid post can be saved when `skip_validations` is true. Thus a regression that accidentally re-enables validation would not be caught by the current tests.
